pins.command: t=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$t"' EXIT && d="$t/host with space" && mkdir -p "$d" && cp tools/ratchet.mjs tools/console-ratchet.mjs tools/a11y-ratchet.mjs tools/size-budget.mjs tools/lint-budget.mjs "$d/" || { echo "P1-SETUP: copy failed (not a finding)"; exit 2; }; for n in console-ratchet a11y-ratchet size-budget lint-budget; do node "$d/$n.mjs" --self-test >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "P1-RED: $n self-test fails from a spaced path"; exit 1; }; done; node tools/checks-vendor.mjs --probe >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "P1-RED: no vendorable-checks probe"; exit 1; }
pins.evidence: P1-RED: console-ratchet self-test fails from a spaced path
